description: This source file provides helper methods to generate JWT tokens for different user roles (admin and normal user) for testing purposes in integration tests.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: Helper class to generate JWT tokens for different user roles to facilitate testing.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token with admin user role.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token with normal user roles (none).

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token given a username and roles array.
